name: skin-in-the-game
title_zh: 真金白银押注的AI分析师，每笔预测都晒实盘
tagline_zh: 别再听AI空口预测了。它用Binance预测市场真金白银下注，每笔盈亏、校准度、Brier分数全公开，错了就真亏钱。
tagline_en: Stop taking AI forecasts on faith. This one backs every call with real money on Binance prediction markets—track.
desc_en: Use when the user wants an AI analyst that backs its market calls with real money on Binance prediction markets, or asks about its track record, calibration, Brier score, unclaimed prediction winnings, betting its own money, accountable forecasting, or "put your money where your mouth is". Drives the `skin` CLI on top of Binance Agentic Wallet (`baw`) and the Binance MCP Server.
why_zh: 机制上杜绝嘴炮：预测必须过Binance Agentic Wallet真金下单，盈亏直接进它的战绩表。
why_en: Skin in the game by design: every forecast must clear a real-money trade via Binance Agentic Wallet. P&L, calibration, and Brier.
limit_zh: 只认Binance预测市场，且本机需装好baw CLI和Binance MCP Server；它只负责下单和记账。
limit_en: Binance prediction markets only; requires baw CLI + Binance MCP Server locally. It places and tracks trades—doesn't custody your funds or cover.
title_en: AI analyst that bets real money on its own market calls
